description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Token_Text, which represents a text token in the HTML Purifier library, including its data, whitespace status, and methods for instantiation and conversion to a node.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Token_Text
classes.description: A class representing a text token in the HTML Purifier system, containing properties for the token's data, whitespace status, and methods for initialization and conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of HTMLPurifier_Token_Text with provided data, and determines if the data is whitespace.

methods.name: toNode
methods.description: Converts the token to an HTMLPurifier_Node_Text object, transferring data and whitespace status.
